title: Actionable Docker preflight for e2e-agent smoke harness
intended_behavior: The e2e-agent harness checks Docker daemon availability before docker compose up, reports a clear actionable preflight failure when Docker is unavailable, and only runs managed cleanup after the stack has actually started. When Docker is available, the harness still starts the real docker-compose stack.
observed_prior_behavior: When Docker was unavailable, pnpm test:smoke attempted docker compose up, failed with a daemon connection error, then attempted cleanup and emitted a second daemon failure.
